about: The user settings as read back (stored with the session; from older versions or edited by hand): the defaults, with every stored key over them, then each known field coerced: numbers clamped (zoom and previewZoom 50–200, default 100; navigationSize 10–14, default 12; tabSize 10–13, default 11; a value that is not a number, or 0, gives the default; numeric strings are read as numbers); choices kept only when known, else their default; flags true only when true (wide, showHistoryButtons, readingFormat, editSplit, newNoteProperties, stampModified, cjkEmphasis, groupCounts) or false only when false (richEdit, typeMarkdown, exportToc); propertyTemplate cut to 2000 UTF-16 code units, the default when not a string; searchExclude and aiLibraries: absolute paths, each once (letter case and separators aside), at most 200, at most 1024 long. Migrations: typeface 'balanced' without typographyVersion becomes 'literata'; typographyVersion is set to 1; touchpadScroll 'smooth' (unreleased builds) becomes smoothScroll 'touchpad' unless that is 'touchpad' or 'all', and touchpadScroll is removed; aiTarget is removed. sidebar, split, outline and tabGroups' items are kept as stored, and so is any key of another name. input.stored (null reads as {}) → expected settings.

cases.name: zero gives the default
cases.why: 0 is read as no value, so the default comes back rather than the minimum.

cases.name: true is one
cases.why: A true is read as the number 1, then clamped.
